BrochureContent.Content:
3 Bedroom detached home built in 1973 on a large plot within walking distance of Ballybofey, this property would benefit from some modernisation and energy efficiency upgrades but is available to move in.

Situated in the peaceful rural setting of Sessiaghoneill, Ballybofey, this three-bedroom detached residence extends to approximately 108 sq m and offers well-proportioned and versatile accommodation throughout. Set on a generous site with established gardens, the property enjoys a pleasant countryside setting while remaining within easy reach of Ballybofey and its range of local amenities.

Built in 1973, the property retains a number of traditional features while offering excellent scope for modernisation and improvement. With its spacious accommodation, generous outdoor space and useful additional storage, this property represents an appealing opportunity for those seeking a detached family home with the potential to create a residence tailored to their own requirements.

The accommodation comprises of three bedrooms, with two useful storage spaces located on the first floor. These additional spaces provide valuable storage and versatility for a variety of uses. The property also benefits from a solid fuel stove with a back boiler, which assists in heating the home`s hot water and radiators, providing an additional heating option.

Outside, the property is approached via a gravel driveway with ample parking for numerous cars. The front garden is laid to lawn and features a variety of fruit trees, with mature hedging to the boundaries providing privacy and a pleasant established setting. To the rear of the property is a raised garden area, also laid to lawn, providing an attractive outdoor space with potential for gardening, relaxation and family enjoyment.

Located in Sessiaghoneill, the property enjoys a peaceful countryside setting while remaining within convenient reach of Ballybofey, where a wide range of shops, schools, services and amenities are available. The location also provides access to the surrounding countryside and wider road network, making it an appealing choice for those seeking a home in a quiet yet accessible part of Co. Donegal. An early viewing is highly recommended.

---

A concrete step leads to the entrance hallway.

Entrance Hallway: 15.7 x 5.6 ft, with tiled flooring.

Living Room: 15 x 11.5 ft, with timber flooring. Features an open fireplace, with a decorative tiled surround.

Kitchen / Dining Room: 12 x 11 ft, with tiled flooring and built-in wall and base kitchen units, with a tiled surround. Stainless steel single sink and drainer unit, with mixer taps over. There is also a solid fuel stove, with a back boiler to aid in heating water and the radiators.

Rear Entrance Hallway: Tiled flooring, and solid wooden door leading to the rear.

Bedroom One: 14.5 x 10 ft, with timber flooring.

Bedroom Two: 13.4 x 8.9 ft, with carpet flooring.

Bedroom Three: 8 x 8 ft, with carpet flooring.

Main Bathroom: Tiled flooring, with a white three-piece suite. A mains shower over the bath, with a glass shower screen and a PVC panelled bath surround.
Staircase leading to the first floor.

First Floor Storage Space: 14.6 x 10.7 ft, with timber flooring.

First Floor Storage Space (Two): 9.1 x 10.7 ft.

Outside: Gravel driveway, with ample parking for numerous cars. The front garden is laid to lawn, featuring a variety of fruit trees, and mature hedging to the boundaries. To the rear of the property is a raised garden, which is also laid to lawn.
